reviews.title: Good Laptop for school work and game streaming,
reviews.body: Ryzen processor does well and benchmarks well against intel. Screen is the low point not bad but not the 3x Amoled I'm used to. Large 16 inch canvas for getting work and school done. Was surprised how well performs with only 8GB ram. Backlit keyboard and metal casing. Track pad is not Mac or Galaxy
reviews.excerpt: Track pad is not Mac or Galaxy Book Pro.

reviews.title: Fantastic! Sleek design, amazing battery life, & AI features.
reviews.body: I received this HP 16” OmniBook 3 Laptop with Next Gen AI 16, Snapdragon X, 16 GB Ram, and 256 GB Ram from Influenster for testing purposes in exchange for my honest review. This HP laptop arrived so quickly! I've been testing it out the past few weeks and I must say, the battery life is impressive!
reviews.excerpt: From using a Google Chromebook this HP OmniBook is a HUGE upgrade for me.
